properties.description: Migrated from DataStage Server Job 'J139_Transbk_Mcf_Cuentas' (JobType=0, DateModified=2021-10-28). Category: \Jobs\Hito_2\Agreement\J139_Transbk_Mcf. Reads pre-filtered Cuentas segment (EDWOS.TRANSBK.MCF.CUENTA.TXT.FINAL), applies multi-stage transformation (Trf_Mcf_Cuentas, Trf_AP, Trf_ACL, Trf_ACI, Trf_AAH, Trf_AF, Trf_ACR), performs hash-based lookups (Hsh_Consultas=Teradata query lookup, Hsh_DicAgreement, Hsh_Vigentes, Hsh_ACI_AAH, Hsh_AF), runs pivoting operations (Pivote_ACI, Pivote_AAH, Pivote_AF, Coll_ACL, EIH_Retro), and writes 22 output TXT files to $PathOutput for downstream FLoad jobs. Stages: CSeqFileStage(x13), CTransformerStage(x7), CHashedFileStage(x5), CCustomStage(x5-pivots).

activities.name: Transform_MCF_Cuentas
activities.description: Core transformation of Cuentas flat file to 22 EDW output files. Maps to DataStage stages: Seq_MCF_Cuentas(source) -> Trf_Mcf_Cuentas -> [Hsh_Consultas lookup] -> [Hsh_DicAgreement lookup] -> [Trf_AP, Trf_ACL, Trf_ACI, Trf_AAH, Trf_AF splits] -> [Pivot operations] -> [22 CSeqFileStage sinks]. ADF: Mapping Data Flow (complex, multi-sink). NOTE: Pivot transformations (Pivote_ACI, Pivote_AAH, Pivote_AF) and hash lookups require custom Data Flow logic.
